description: Call Monja's typed current-principal REST operation and execute a caller-supplied GraphQL document through the installed @monja/client package.

input.description: Provide workflowInput.graphql.query as a required string, workflowInput.graphql.operationName as an optional string, and workflowInput.graphql.variables as an optional JSON object. Credentials and transport configuration are inherited from the host environment, never from workflow input or argv.

output.description: Return exactly one JSON object record containing status, a safe rest principal summary, and caller-requested graphql data.
